factCards.text: The Magnavox Odyssey, sold from 1972, was the first home video game console. Its plug-in cards held no memory at all — they simply rewired the circuits inside the machine.
factCards.sourceTitle: The Strong National Museum of Play — Magnavox Odyssey

factCards.text: Halo: Combat Evolved, made by Bungie, was a launch title for the original Xbox in November 2001 and became the console's defining game.
OUYA raised its money on Kickstarter in 2012 and shipped in 2013, but sold poorly; the company's software assets went to Razer in 2015.
